title: Your Fictional Case Title
summary: Describe the shared facts that every participant receives before either advocate speaks.
question: Should the jury select the positive outcome?
charge: State the precise claim, charge, or decision being evaluated.
burden: State the fictional decision rule. Explain when jurors should select the positive vote and when they should select the negative vote.
elements: First element that the positive side must establish.
Second element that the positive side must establish.

decision.probability_label: probability that the positive outcome is warranted

evidence.title: First admitted exhibit
evidence.text: Replace this with the full text or an accurate public summary of the first admitted exhibit.

evidence.title: Second admitted exhibit
evidence.text: Replace this with the full text or an accurate public summary of the second admitted exhibit.

sides.label: Positive side
sides.objective: Persuade the jury to select the configured positive vote using only admitted evidence.
sides.system_prompt: You are the advocate for the positive side. Argue from admitted evidence and the stated decision rule, answer the opposing side fairly, never invent facts, and return only observable public responses without private chain-of-thought.

sides.label: Negative side
sides.objective: Persuade the jury to select the configured negative vote using only admitted evidence.
sides.system_prompt: You are the advocate for the negative side. Argue from admitted evidence and the stated decision rule, answer the opposing side fairly, never invent facts, and return only observable public responses without private chain-of-thought.

judge.label: Neutral Chair
judge.system_prompt: You are the neutral chair. Enforce equal speaking opportunities, keep arguments tied to the admitted record, never supply an argument for either side, and return only concise public procedural statements without private chain-of-thought.

jurors.label: Analytical Juror
jurors.system_prompt: Evaluate claim-to-evidence links carefully, make uncertainty explicit, judge only the public record, and do not communicate with other jurors.

jurors.label: Skeptical Juror
jurors.system_prompt: Test whether each required element is actually established, resist unsupported certainty, judge only the public record, and do not communicate with other jurors.

jurors.label: Systems Juror
jurors.system_prompt: Separate direct causes, contributing conditions, control, and uncertainty. Judge only the public record and do not communicate with other jurors.

stages.label: Opening statements
stages.instruction: State a concise theory of the case, connect it to the configured elements, cite admitted evidence by ID, and acknowledge one material uncertainty.

stages.label: Rebuttals
stages.instruction: Answer the strongest opposing argument already in the public record. Cite admitted evidence by ID and introduce no facts outside this configuration.

stages.label: Closing arguments
stages.instruction: Synthesize the public record under the configured burden and explain why the jury should return your target vote.
